what: MCP server is long-running — changes to recall.ts, store.ts, or server.ts require an MCP server restart to take effect. npm run build compiles to dist/ but the running server process still has old code in memory. Bash tests work (fresh Node process each time) but aide_recall/aide_search via MCP use stale code until server restarts. Restart by restarting the Claude Code session or re-running aide-memory serve.
why: Ranking fix was compiled and verified via bash but aide_recall via MCP still returned project-wide memories. Wasted a full round of live testing before realizing the server needed a restart.
